turns.text: Vouchers are a discount we fund, not a way of paying: take an order's voucher payments off its item prices, shared across its items in proportion to price.
What's our realized price by category, against the item price?

csvChecks.ask: realized_by_category.csv with columns product_category_name,item_value_brl,voucher_brl,realized_pct: every product_category_name as in the data (products with no category left out), realized_pct = (item value − voucher) ÷ item value in %
